meaning: When the control has this error, the melting system is shut down.
checks: Check the 090 center temperature sensor and the wiring to the sensor (black and yellow wires, terminals 12 & 14).

meaning: When the control has this error, it continues operation using only the Snow/Ice Sensor.
checks: Check the Outdoor Sensor and wiring from the terminal.

meaning: When the control has this error, it continues operation using only the Snow/Ice Sensor.
checks: Check the Outdoor Sensor and wiring from the terminal.

meaning: If the red and black wires on the 090 Sensor are shorted together, the power supply itself is shorted. When this occurs, the control continuously cycles through the start of the power up routine.
causes: Red and black wires on the 090 Sensor shorted together
checks: This fault should be repaired immediately or damage to the control could result.

meaning: When the control has this error, the melting system can only be operated using a remote enable signal.
causes: Reversal of the yellow and brown wires
checks: Check the 090 heater circuit (red and black wires, terminals 11 & 12).

meaning: When the control has this error, the system can only be operated using a remote enable signal.
checks: Check the 090 water circuit (black and blue wires, terminals 12 & 13).

checks: Check the 090 edge temperature sensor and the wiring to the sensor (black and brown wires, terminals 12 & 15).
